adapted: transcript audit uses the active runtime's current-session API or store, with active-context fallback and a no-cross-session boundary
cross-model review selects from the runtime's available models and has explicit same-model and no-subagent fallbacks
local log placement now requires an ignored repository work-artifact path when available
removed upstream `disable-model-invocation: true`; an installed user-invoked skill is invisible to the agent, so a typed invocation fails in any runtime that does not expand the skill name first
the rules keep "so a reviewer can re-run it" instead of upstream's pointer to the encode-lessons-in-structure skill, which is not shipped here
